description: Post a message on a ticket. With internal_note=true it is an internal note visible only to agents. OTHERWISE IT IS DELIVERED TO THE CUSTOMER on the ticket's channel (email, WhatsApp, chat...) and cannot be recalled — confirm the text first. Trengo: POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/messages.

attachment_ids.description: Email channels only: ids of previously uploaded attachments.

internal_note.description: true = internal note for agents only; false/omitted = sent to the customer.

message.description: The message. May contain HTML when the channel is email.

subject.description: Email channels only. Trengo prefixes it with 'Re:' when replying.

name: trengo_send_ticket_message
title: Send a ticket message
